description: Budgets for the browser stage, one file, enforced in CI. 'bytes' is the decoded payload of every response a page load causes and 'requests' counts those responses; both are deterministic. 'longTasks' counts main-thread tasks over 50 ms during the load and a short settle window, and 'longestTaskMs' is the longest single block, kept as a loose runaway guard: a two-core CI runner can block for over a second on its own startup, so the count is the signal and the ceiling only catches a script that never yields. Budgets are today's measurements plus a small margin; raise one only with a recorded reason.
